d:
Mokama ke purv vidhayak bahubli anant sinh ki chhoti beti shivangi ki shadi (25 navanbar) ko lekar unke paitrik ganv ladma men shahi aur aitihasik taiyariyan chal rahi hain. shadi ke is bhavy samaroh men anant sinh apne hone vale damad rishikesh kumar ko karib 2.5 karor rupye ki lagjari laind rovar diphendar SUV aur apne chhote bete abhinav sinh ko BMW kar gipht kar rahe hain.
Is vidiyo men dekhie anant sinh ki beti ke byah ki puri insaid stori:
Shahi tohphe: damad ko 2.5 karor ki diphendar aur bete ke janeoo par BMW kara.
